name: Dr. Amara Okafor
look: a brilliant museum curator and scientist with brown skin, a big high puff of brown curls with loose curls framing her face, and gold hoop earrings; a white lab coat over an orange turtleneck, dark wide trousers, brown boots, round tortoiseshell glasses, holding a brown clipboard
personality: Precise, calm, a bit of a know-it-all; respects Foxley as a fellow genius.

mouth.method: small patch around the mouth from pose 2, else draw along the smile
mouth.note: Curls and glasses differ slightly between poses 1 and 2; keep the patch tight to the mouth, well below the glasses.
